4743.o: Travel to the Wyrmbog in Dustwallow Marsh. Find the ancient drake, Emberstrife and beat him without mercy until his will is broken. It is at that moment which you must place the Unforged Seal of Ascension before the great beast. You must then be quick to use the Orb of Draconic Energy on his weakened form and claim dominion over his mental faculties. Control the beast and force the Flames of the Black Dragonflight upon the Unforged Seal of Ascension!

4767.o: Bring 10 Highperch Wyvern Eggs to Elu in Freewind Post.

4768.o: Bring the Darkstone Tablet to Shadow Mage Vivian Lagrave in Kargath.

4769.n: Vivian Lagrave and the Darkstone Tablet

4770.o: Escort Pao'ka Swiftmountain from Highperch, and then talk to Motega Firemane in Whitereach Post.

4771.o: Place Dawn's Gambit in the Viewing Room of the Scholomance. Defeat Vectus, then return to Betina Bigglezink.

4781.n: Components for the Enchanted Gold Bloodrobe
4781.o: Bring a Gold Bar to Xizk Goodstitch in Stranglethorn Vale.

4782.n: Components for the Enchanted Gold Bloodrobe
4782.o: Return to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

4783.n: Components for the Enchanted Gold Bloodrobe
4783.o: Bring 10 Vials of Hatefury Blood and 1 Lesser Infernal Stone to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

4784.n: Components for the Enchanted Gold Bloodrobe
4784.o: Bring some Fine Gold Thread, 2 Smoldering Coals, and a Soul Shard to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

4786.o: Wait for Menara Voidrender to complete your robe and then speak to her again.

4787.o: Bring the Ancient Egg to Yeh'kinya in Tanaris.

4788.o: Bring the Fifth and Sixth Mosh'aru Tablets to Prospector Ironboot in Tanaris.

4808.o: Give Tinkee's Letter to Felnok Steelspring.

4809.o: Bring 8 Uncracked Chillwind Horns to Felnok Steelspring.

4810.o: Bring Felnok's Package to Tinkee Steamboil in the Burning Steppes.

4821.o: Return the Alien Egg to Hagar Lightninghoof in Freewind Post.

4841.o: Kill 12 Galak Scouts, 10 Galak Wranglers, and 6 Galak Windchasers, and then return to Cliffwatcher Longhorn in Freewind Post.

4842.o: Follow Donova Snowden's instructions, then report back.

4862.o: Travel to Blackrock Spire and collect 15 Spire Spider Eggs for Kibler. By the sound of it, these eggs could be found near spiders.

4865.o: Report your findings to Motega Firemane.

4866.o: In the heart of Blackrock Spire you will find Mother Smolderweb. Engage her and get her to poison you. Chances are good that you will have to kill her as well. Return to Ragged John when you are poisoned so that he can 'milk' you.

4867.o: Read Warosh's Scroll. Bring Warosh's Mojo to Warosh.

4881.o: Warn Kanati Greycloud at Whitereach Post of the plot to kill him.

4882.o: Take the Blue-feathered Necklace to Trull Failbane at Bloodvenom Post.

4883.o: Take the Blue-feathered Necklace to Nara Wildmane.

4903.o: Slay Highlord Omokk, War Master Voone, and Overlord Wyrmthalak. Recover Important Blackrock Documents. Return to Warlord Goretooth in Kargath when the mission has been accomplished.

4904.o: Escort Lakota Windsong from the Darkcloud Pinnacle, and then talk to Thalia Amberhide at Freewind Post.

4921.o: Find Mankrik's wife and then return to him in the Crossroads.

4941.o: Speak with Eitrigg in Orgrimmar. When you have discussed matters with Eitrigg, seek council from Thrall. You recall having seen Eitrigg in Thrall's chamber.

4961.n: Cleansing of the Orb of Orahil
4961.o: Kill the Demon of the Orb, then speak with Tabetha.

4962.o: Take the Felhas Ruby and use it on one of the Felhounds found in Desolace. After successful, bring the Felhas Ruby and the Imprisoned Felhound Spirit back to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

4963.o: Take the Infus Emerald and use it on one of the Infernals found in Desolace. After successful, bring the Infus Emerald and the Imprisoned Infernal Spirit back to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

4964.o: Wait for Menara Voidrender to complete the Orb of Dar'Orahil and then speak to her again.

4966.o: Protect Kanati Greycloud from the centaur attack.

4969.n: Knowledge of the Orb of Orahil
4969.o: Speak to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

4971.o: Use the Temporal Displacer near one of Andorhal's silos and uncover Temporal Parasites. Slay 10 Temporal Parasites, and then return the Temporal Displacer to Chromie in the Andorhal Inn, Western Plaguelands.

4972.o: Locate 5 Andorhal Watches, found in lockboxes amongst the rubble of the city. Return with them to Chromie in the Andorhal Inn, Western Plaguelands.

4973.o: Locate 5 Andorhal Watches amongst the rubble of the city, and return with them to Chromie in the Andorhal Inn, Western Plaguelands.

4974.o: Travel to Blackrock Spire and slay Warchief Rend Blackhand. Take his head and return to Orgrimmar.

4975.o: Wait for Menara Voidrender to complete the Orb of Noh'Orahil and then speak to her again.

4976.o: Return the Cleansed Infernal Orb to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

4981.o: Travel to Blackrock Spire and find out what happened to Bijou.

4982.o: Find Bijou's Belongings and return them to her. You recall her mentioning that she stashed them on the bottom floor of the city.

4983.o: Take Bijou's Reconnaissance Report back to Grandmaster Lexlort in Kargath.

4984.o: Destroy 8 Diseased Wolves, and then return to Mulgris Deepriver at the Writhing Haunt, Western Plaguelands.

4985.o: Destroy 8 Diseased Grizzlies, and then return to Mulgris Deepriver at the Writhing Haunt, Western Plaguelands.

4987.o: Based on the magic enchanted within the Glyphed Oaken Branch, its delivery to the Cenarion Circle in Thunder Bluff is the next step the tauren druid sought. Seek one of the druids there for assistance.

5021.o: The ramblings of the ghostly woman indicated that she needed a package delivered. She claimed that it was where her horse was. As to where the horse is or where the package was to be delivered - the ghost remains incomprehensible.

5023.o: Check with the Royal Overseers of the Undercity to learn the whereabouts of a Jeremiah Felstone. There is usually a census officer located near guild and tabard registration.

5041.o: Find and return Crossroads' Supply Crates to Thork in the Barrens.

5047.o: Talk to Malyfous Darkhammer in Everlook.

5049.o: Find Jeremiah Payson in the Undercity and see if he is in fact Jeremiah Felstone. If he is, then perhaps he'd like the package Janice Felstone made for him.

5050.o: Return to Janice Felstone in Western Plaguelands her Good Luck Half-Charm.

5051.o: Locate the other half of the Good Luck Charm somewhere on the Felstone Farm in Western Plaguelands and reassemble it. Give the Good Luck Charm to Janice Felstone on the Felstone Farm, Western Plaguelands.

5052.o: Bring a Blood Shard to Mangletooth in Camp Taurajo in the Barrens. Collect more Blood Shards if you want him to bless you with Agamaggan's power.

5054.o: Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook in Winterspring wants you to kill Ursius.

5055.o: Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook in Winterspring wants you to kill Brumeran.

5056.o: Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook in Winterspring wants you to defeat Shy-Rotam.

5057.o: Bring Storm Shadowhoof's Marker to Melor Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff.

5062.o: Gather 10 bushels of Incendia Agave, and then consult Magatha Grimtotem on Elder Rise in Thunderbluff.

5063.o: In order to create the Cap of the Scarlet Savant, you will be required to bring the following items back to Malyfous Darkhammer: 1 Pristine Hide of the Beast; 5 Frayed Abomination Stitchings; 8 Arcane Crystals; 5 Enchanted Scarlet Thread.  You will also be required to pay 50 gold pieces for the crafting of the item.

5064.o: Locate and retrieve the three Secret Notes in Darkcloud Pinnacle.

5065.o: Bring the Third and Fourth Mosh'aru Tablets to Prospector Ironboot in Tanaris.

5067.o: In order to create the Leggings of Arcana, you will be required to bring the following items back to Malyfous Darkhammer: 1 Pristine Hide of the Beast; 5 Frayed Abomination Stitchings; 5 Arcanite Bars; 5 Frostwhisper's Embalming Fluid. You will also be required to pay 50 gold pieces for the crafting of the item.

5068.o: In order to create the Breastplate of Bloodthirst, you will be required to bring the following items back to Malyfous Darkhammer: 1 Pristine Hide of the Beast; 10 Frayed Abomination Stitchings; 5 Arcanite Bars; 5 Skin of Shadow. You will also be required to pay 50 gold pieces for the crafting of the item.

5082.o: Donova Snowden in Winterspring wants you to kill 8 Winterfall Pathfinders, 8 Winterfall Den Watchers, and 8 Winterfall Totemics.

5083.o: Bring the Empty Firewater Flask to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.

5084.o: Search the Deadwood furbolg camp in northern Felwood for a clue.

5085.o: Report back to Donova Snowden with your findings.

5086.o: Collect 3 Toxic Horror Droplets for Donova Snowden in Winterspring.

5087.o: Find the Winterfall Runners and stop them from delivering their shipment to Winterfall Village.

5088.o: Slay Arikara. Bring her remains and the Incendia powder to Motega Firemane in Whitereach Post as proof of your deed.

5093.n: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!

5096.o: Proceed to the Scarlet Crusade's base camp between Felstone Field and Dalson's Tears and destroy their command tent. Place the Scourge banner at the camp, and then return to High Executor Derrington at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

5098.o: Using the Beacon Torch, mark each tower in Andorhal; you will need to stand in the doorway of the tower to successfully mark it. Once all four towers are marked, return the Beacon Torch to High Executor Derrington at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

5103.o: Someone in this world must know what to do with these gauntlets. Good luck!

5121.o: Donova Snowden in Winterspring wants you to defeat High Chief Winterfall.

5123.o: Bring the Crudely-written Log to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.

5124.o: Bring Malyfous Darkhammer 6 Enchanted Thorium Bars, 2 Essence of Fire, and 4 Star Rubies. You will also need to turn in your Unfired Plate Gauntlets.

5126.o: Speak with Lorax. Listen to what he has to say.

5127.o: Travel to Blackrock Spire and find Goraluk Anvilcrack. Slay him and then use the Blood Stained Pike upon his corpse. After his soul has been siphoned, the pike will be Soul Stained. You must also find the Unforged Rune Covered Breastplate. Return both the Soul Stained Pike and the Unforged Rune Covered Breastplate to Lorax in Winterspring.

5128.o: Take the Crudely-written Log to Kelek Skykeeper in southern Felwood.

5145.o: Bring 2 Tough Scorpid Breastplates, 2 Tough Scorpid Gloves, and 10 Worn Dragonscales to Thorkaf Dragoneye in the Badlands. Completing this quest will give you access to the Dragonscale Leatherworking arts. The completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Elemental Leatherworking and Tribal Leatherworking; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.

5146.o: Bring 2 Heart of Fire, 2 Globe of Water, 2 Core of Earth, and 2 Breath of Wind to Brumn Winterhoof in the Arathi Mountains. Completing this quest will give you access to the Elemental Leatherworking arts. The completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Dragonscale Leatherworking and Tribal Leatherworking; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.

5147.o: Slay Arnak Grimtotem and bring proof of your deed to Cliffwatcher Longhorn in Freewind Post.

5148.o: Bring a Wild Leather Vest and a Wild Leather Helmet to Se'Jib in Stranglethorn Vale. Completing this quest will give you access to the Tribal Leatherworking arts. The completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Dragonscale Leatherworking and Elemental Leatherworking; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.

5151.o: Slay the beast and bring back the Hypercapacitor Gizmo and Panther Cage Key to Wizlo Bearingshiner.

5152.o: Speak with Marlene, south of the Ruins of Andorhal.

5153.o: Bring Joseph's Wedding Ring to Chromie.

5154.o: Bring the Annals of Darrowshire to Chromie in Andorhal.

5155.o: Enter Jaedenar and slay 4 Jaedenar Hounds, 4 Jaedenar Guardsmen, 6 Jaedenar Adepts, and 6 Jaedenar Cultists before returning to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.

5156.o: Seek out and destroy 2 Entropic Beasts and 2 Entropic Horrors while exploring Shatter Scar Vale. After checking to see if the craters there are still filled with corrupt fel water, return to Taronn Redfeather in Felwood.

5157.o: Take the Empty Canteen to the Moon Well in the center of Jaedenar and fill it before returning to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.

5158.o: Take the Corrupt Moon Well Water to Islen Waterseer in the Barrens.

5159.o: Take the Purified Moon Well Water to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.

5160.o: Travel to Winterspring and find Haleh. Give her Awbee's scale.

5161.o: Speak with Haleh if you wish to continue.

5162.o: Speak with Jeziba in the Plaguelands. He resides in Andorhal.

5163.o: Take Umi's Mechanical Yeti and scare her friends with it: Legacki in Everlook (Winterspring) Sprinkle in Gadgetzan (Tanaris) Quixxil in Marshal's Refuge (Un'Goro Crater) When you are done, bring the Mechanical Yeti back to Umi.

5164.o: Read from the Catalogue of the Wayward.

5165.o: Using the Purified Moon Well Water, douse the flames of the four braziers of protection within Shadow Hold in Felwood, then return to Greta Mosshoof in the Emerald Sanctuary.

5166.o: To forge the Breastplate of the Chromatic Flight, you will be required to bring the following items to Jeziba the 'Sculptor': 1 Chromatic Carapace. 10 Brilliant Chromatic Scales. 10 Blood of Heroes. 10 Frayed Abomination Stitchings.

5167.o: To forge the Legplates of the Chromatic Defier, you will be required to bring the following items to Jeziba the 'Sculptor': 1 Chromatic Carapace. 10 Brilliant Chromatic Scales. 10 Blood of Heroes. 5 Skin of Shadow.

5168.o: Bring Davil's Libram and Redpath's Shield to Carlin Redpath.

5181.o: Bring the Skull of Horgus and the Shattered Sword of Marduk to Carlin Redpath at Light's Hope Chapel.

5202.o: Search through Jaedenar to discover what the Blood Red Key is used for.

5203.o: Escort Arko'narin to where Lightforge and her equipment are being held, and then protect her as you escape Shadow Hold. Afterwards, seek out Jessir Moonbow in Felwood to let her know what's happened to her friends.

5204.o: Return to Jaedenar and kill the succubus Rakaiah before finding the Remains of Trey Lightforge.

5206.o: Bring 5 Resonating Skulls and the Mystic Crystal to Carlin Redpath in Eastern Plaguelands.

5210.o: Bring the Extended Annals of Darrowshire to Carlin Redpath in Eastern Plaguelands.

5211.o: Free 15 Darrowshire Spirits and return to Carlin Redpath.

5212.o: Recover 10 Plagued Flesh Samples from Stratholme and return them to Betina Bigglezink. You suspect that any creature in Stratholme would have said flesh sample.

5213.o: Travel to Stratholme and search the ziggurats. Find and return new Scourge Data to Betina Bigglezink.

5214.o: Find Fras Siabi's smoke shop in Stratholme and recover a box of Siabi's Premium Tobacco. Return to Smokey LaRue when the job is done.

5228.o: Speak with Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

5229.o: Go to Felstone Field in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there. It may have a key that will allow access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Felstone Field Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

5230.o: Bring the Filled Felstone Field Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

5231.o: Go to Dalson's Tears in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Dalson's Tears Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

5232.o: Bring the Filled Dalson's Tears Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

5233.o: Go to the Writhing Haunt in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Writhing Haunt Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

5234.o: Bring the Filled Writhing Haunt Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at The Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

5235.o: Go to Gahrron's Withering in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Gahrron's Withering Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

5236.o: Bring the Filled Gahrron's Withering Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

5242.o: Kill Moora and Salia, and bring Shadow Lord Fel'dan's Head to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.

5243.o: Travel to Stratholme, in the north. Search the supply crates that litter the city and recover 5 Stratholme Holy Water. Return to Leonid Barthalomew the Revered when you have collected enough of the blessed fluid.

5251.o: Travel to Stratholme and find Archivist Galford of the Scarlet Crusade. Destroy him and burn down the Scarlet Archive.

5262.o: Take the Head of Balnazzar to Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff in the Eastern Plaguelands.

5263.o: Venture to Stratholme and destroy Baron Rivendare. Take his head and return to Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff.

5264.o: Speak with Lord Maxwell Tyrosus. He is inside the church.

5265.o: Open the Argent Hold and claim your reward.

5281.o: Find Egan. You only know that he was last seen around Stratholme.

5282.o: Use Egan's Blaster on the ghostly and spectral citizens of Stratholme. When the restless souls break free from their ghostly shells, use the blaster again - freedom will be theirs! Free 15 Restless Souls and return to Egan.

5301.o: To become an armorsmith, you must make the following items and return them to Okothos: 4 Ornate Mithril Helms, 2 Ornate Mithril Boots, 1 Ornate Mithril Breastplate.

5302.o: To become a Weaponsmith, you must make the following items and return them to Borgosh: 4 Moonsteel Broadswords, 4 Massive Iron Axes, 2 Heavy Mithril Axes, and 2 Big Black Maces.

5305.o: Travel to Stratholme and kill the Crimson Hammersmith. Recover the Crimson Hammersmith's Apron and return to Lilith.

5306.o: Travel to Blackrock Spire and slay Shadow Hunter Vosh'gajin. Recover Vosh'gajin's Snakestone and return to Kilram.

5307.o: Find the Black Guard Swordsmith in Stratholme and destroy him. Recover the Insignia of the Black Guard and return to Seril Scourgebane.

5341.o: Venture to the Scholomance and recover the Barov family fortune. Four deeds make up this fortune: The Deed to Caer Darrow; The Deed to Brill; The Deed to Tarren Mill; and The Deed to Southshore. Return to Alexi Barov when you have completed this task.

5342.o: Travel to Chillwind Camp - Alliance territory - and assassinate Weldon Barov. Take his head and return to Alexi Barov. Be warned, Weldon will probably be well protected by Alliance scum.

5361.o: Deliver Cliffwatcher Longhorn Report to Nataka Longhorn at Ghost Walker Post in Desolace.

5381.o: Retrieve the Demon Box from Thunder Axe Fortress, and return it, along with the Demon Pick to Taiga Wisemane in Shadowprey Village.

5382.o: Find Doctor Theolen Krastinov inside the Scholomance. Destroy him, then burn the Remains of Eva Sarkhoff and the Remains of Lucien Sarkhoff. Return to Eva Sarkhoff when the task is complete.

5384.o: Return to the Scholomance with the Blood of Innocents. Find the porch and place the Blood of Innocents in the brazier. Kirtonos will come to feast upon your soul. Fight valiantly, do not give an inch! Destroy Kirtonos and return to Eva Sarkhoff.

5385.o: Return the Remains of Trey Lightforge to Jessir Moonbow in Felwood.

5386.o: Talk to Jinar'Zillen at Shadowprey Village, and then bring Nataka Longhorn 2 Bloodbelly fish.

5441.o: Use the Foreman's Blackjack on Lazy Peons when they're sleeping. Wake up 5 peons, then return the Foreman's Blackjack to Foreman Thazz'ril in the Valley of Trials.

5461.o: Travel to the Arathi Highlands, to the ruins of Stromgarde. Search Stromgarde for a Keepsake of Remembrance. If you find such an item, return with it to Magistrate Marduke.

5462.o: Travel to Light's Hope in Eastern Plaguelands and seek out Leonid Barthalomew the Revered. Show him the Keepsake of Remembrance and tell him all that you have discovered.

5463.o: Travel to Stratholme and find Menethil's Gift. Place the Keepsake of Remembrance upon the unholy ground.

5464.o: Take the Soulbound Keepsake to Leonid Barthalomew in Eastern Plaguelands.

5465.o: Return to Magistrate Marduke in Caer Darrow. Show him the Soulbound Keepsake.

5466.o: Find Ras Frostwhisper in the Scholomance. When you have found him, use the Soulbound Keepsake on his undead visage. Should you succeed in reverting him to a mortal, strike him down and recover the Human Head of Ras Frostwhisper. Take the head back to Magistrate Marduke.

5481.o: Collect 3 Gloom Weed and deliver them to Junior Apothecary Holland in the Brill graveyard.

5482.o: Collect 10 Doom Weed and deliver them back to Junior Apothecary Holland.

5501.o: Bring 10 Kodo Bones from the Kodo Graveyard to Bibbly F'utzbuckle at Kormek's Hut.

5502.o: Return your ward to the Orgrimmar orphanage by handing in the Orcish Orphan Whistle to Orphan Matron Battlewail in the Valley of Honor.

5504.o: Bring 10 Argent Dawn Valor Tokens to Quartermaster Hasana at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

5513.o: Bring 10 Argent Dawn Valor Tokens to Quartermaster Breechlock at Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands.

5514.o: Bring the Imbued Skeletal Fragments and 15 gold coins to Krinkle Goodsteel in Gadgetzan.

5515.o: Locate Jandice Barov in the Scholomance and destroy her. From her corpse recover Krastinov's Bag of Horrors. Return the bag to Eva Sarkhoff.

5517.o: Bring 25 Argent Dawn Valor Tokens to Quartermaster Breechlock at Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands.

5518.o: Bring 4 Bolts of Runecloth, 8 Rugged Leather, 2 Rune Threads, and Ogre Tannin to Knot Thimblejack. He is currently chained inside the Gordok wing of Dire Maul.

5522.o: Bring the Frozen Eggs to Leonid Barthalomew in the Eastern Plaguelands.

5524.o: Bring 25 Argent Dawn Valor Tokens to Quartermaster Hasana at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

5526.o: Find the Felvine in Dire Maul and acquire a shard from it. Chances are you'll only be able to procure one with the demise of Alzzin the Wildshaper. Use the Reliquary of Purity to securely seal the shard inside, and return it to Rabine Saturna in Nighthaven, Moonglade.

5527.o: Travel to Silithus and search for a Reliquary of Purity within the ruins of Southwind Village. If you are able to find it, return with it to Rabine Saturna in Nighthaven, Moonglade.

5529.o: Kill 20 Plagued Hatchlings, then return to Betina Bigglezink at the Light's Hope Chapel.

5531.o: Bring the Frozen Eggs to Betina Bigglezink.

5534.o: Find Some Rune that the naga have in their possession in the Ruins of Eldarath and return it to Kim'jael in Azshara.

5535.o: Destroy 6 Highborne Apparitions and 6 Highborne Lichlings before returning to Loh'atu in Azshara.

5536.o: Kill 6 Haldarr Satyr, 2 Haldarr Tricksters, 2 Haldarr Felsworn and then return to Loh'atu on the border of Ashenvale.

5542.o: Slay 20 Plaguehound Runts, 5 Plaguehounds and 5 Frenzied Plaguehounds. Return to Tirion Fordring when the task is complete.

5543.o: Slay 30 Plaguebats and return to Tirion Fordring.

5544.o: Seek out the Carrion Grubs and Devourers of the region. Slay them and harvest their meat. Return to Tirion Fordring when you have gathered 15 Slabs of Carrion Worm Meat.

5561.o: Bring five Tamed Kodos and the Kodo Kombobulator back to Smeed Scrabblescrew at Scrabblescrew's Camp.

5581.o: Banish 6 Portals at Mannoroc Coven and return to Taiga Wisemane at Shadowprey Village.

5582.o: Bring the Healthy Dragon Scale to Betina Bigglezink at the Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands.

5644.o: Speak to Aelthalyste in the Undercity.

5646.o: Speak to Aelthalyste in the Undercity.

5648.o: Find Grunt Kor'ja and heal her wounds using Lesser Heal (Rank 2). Afterwards, grant her Power Word: Fortitude and then return to Tai'jin at Razor Hill.

5650.o: Find Deathguard Kel and heal his wounds using Lesser Heal (Rank 2). Afterwards, grant him Power Word: Fortitude and then return to Dark Cleric Beryl in Brill.

5651.o: Speak to Dark Cleric Beryl in Tirisfal Glades.

5658.o: Speak to Aelthalyste in the Undercity.

5660.o: Speak to Aelthalyste in the Undercity.

5661.o: Speak to Aelthalyste in the Undercity.

5662.o: Speak to Aelthalyste in the Undercity.

5663.o: Speak to Aelthalyste in the Undercity.

5679.o: Speak to Aelthalyste in the Undercity.

5721.o: Place the Relic Bundle at the Darrowshire town square. Prevent Davil Lightfire's death until the death of Horgus. Prevent Captain Redpath's death until Redpath the Corrupted appears. Defeat Redpath the Corrupted. Speak with the spirit of Joseph Redpath when he appears at the town square, then speak with Pamela at her home.

5722.o: Search Ragefire Chasm for Maur Grimtotem's corpse and search it for any items of interest.

5723.o: Search Orgrimmar for Ragefire Chasm, then kill 8 Ragefire Troggs and 8 Ragefire Shaman before returning to Rahauro in Thunder Bluff.

5724.o: Take the Grimtotem Satchel to Rahauro in Thunder Bluff.

5725.o: Bring the books Spells of Shadow and Incantations from the Nether to Varimathras in Undercity.

5726.o: Bring a Lieutenant's Insignia to Thrall in Orgrimmar.

5727.o: Take the Lieutenant's Insignia to Neeru Fireblade and speak to him. Gauge if he believes you are a member of the Burning Blade and then return to Thrall in Orgrimmar.

5728.o: Kill Bazzalan and Jergosh the Invoker before returning to Thrall in Orgrimmar.

5729.o: Speak to Neeru Fireblade in Orgrimmar.

5730.o: Speak to Thrall in Orgrimmar and tell him what you've learned.

5741.o: Get the Sceptre of Light and then return it to Azore Aldamort at the tower in Ethel Rethor.

5742.o: Listen to what Tirion Fordring has to say.

5761.o: Enter Ragefire Chasm and slay Taragaman the Hungerer, then bring his heart back to Neeru Fireblade in Orgrimmar.

5762.o: Take Kravel's Crate to Hemet Nesingwary in Stranglethorn.

5763.o: Bring Roon's Kodo Horn to Hemet Nesingwary in Stranglethorn.

5781.o: Travel to the Undercroft - at the southernmost section of the Eastern Plaguelands - and recover Taelan's Hammer. Return to Tirion Fordring upon completion of your objective.

5802.o: Take the Skeleton Key Mold and 2 Thorium Bars to the top of Fire Plume Ridge in Un'Goro Crater. Use the Skeleton Key Mold by the lava lake to forge the Unfinished Skeleton Key. Bring the Unfinished Skeleton Key to Apothecary Dithers at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

5804.o: Destroy Araj the Summoner and bring Araj's Scarab to Apothecary Dithers at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

5821.o: Escort the Gizelton Caravan past the Kolkar Centaur village. Talk with Smeed at Scrabblescrew's Camp for your reward.

5843.o: Bring the Valley of Trials Gift Voucher to Magga.

5844.o: Bring the Camp Narache Gift Voucher to Vorn Skyseer.

5845.o: Travel to Northdale, in the northeastern region of the Eastern Plaguelands, and recover the Symbol of Lost Honor. Return to Tirion Fordring upon completion of your objective.

5846.o: Travel to island of Caer Darrow, in the south-central region of the Plaguelands, and look for any clues as to the whereabouts of the painting.

5847.o: Bring the Deathknell Gift Voucher to Claire Willower in Deathknell.

5848.o: Travel to Stratholme, in the northern part of the Plaguelands. It is in the Scarlet Bastion that you will find the painting 'Of Love and Family,' hidden behind another painting depicting the twin moons of our world. Return the painting to Tirion Fordring.

5861.o: Travel to Uther's Tomb, located in the southern Plaguelands. Show Myranda the Hag Tirion's Gift.

5862.o: Speak to Myranda to gain the Scarlet Illusion. Travel to Hearthglen while under the Scarlet Illusion and deliver Tirion's Gift to Highlord Taelan Fordring. Hearthglen is to the north, Taelan should be inside of Mardenholde Keep.

5863.o: Andi Lynn in Gadgetzan wants you to destroy the Dunemaul Compound by killing 10 Dunemaul Brutes, 10 Dunemaul Enforcers, and Gor'marok the Ravager.

5881.o: Maggran wishes you to deliver a letter to Grish Longrunner at the Great Lift in the Barrens.

5893.o: Bring 10 Coldtooth Supplies to the Horde Quatermaster in Frostwolf Keep.

5901.o: Use the Empty Termite Jar on the Termite Mounds in Eastern Plaguelands. After you've gathered 100 Plagueland Termites, return to Mickey Levine at the Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.

5902.o: Find someplace suitable in the center of the Northridge Lumber Mill in Western Plaguelands to place the Barrel of Plagueland Termites.

5922.o: Use the spell "Teleport: Moonglade" to travel to Moonglade. When you arrive, speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven.

5926.o: Speak with Turak Runetotem on the Elder Rise of Thunder Bluff.

5927.o: Speak with Turak Runetotem on the Elder Rise of Thunder Bluff.

5928.o: Speak with Turak Runetotem on the Elder Rise of Thunder Bluff.

5930.o: Seek out the Great Bear Spirit in northwestern Moonglade and learn what it has to share with you about the nature of the bear. When finished, return to Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven, Moonglade.

5932.o: Return to Thunder Bluff and speak with Turak Runetotem on the Elder Rise.

5941.o: Take the Bundle of Relics to Chromie in Andorhal.

5942.o: Bring Joseph's Key to Joseph's Chest.

5943.o: Escort the Gizelton Caravan through Mannoroc Coven. Talk with Smeed at Scrabblescrew's Camp for your reward.

5944.o: Escort Taelan Fordring out of Hearthglen.

5961.n: The Champion of the Banshee Queen
5961.o: Speak with Nathanos Blightcaller in the Eastern Plaguelands. He is said to have taken up residence at the Marris Stead.

6002.o: Use the Cenarion Lunardust on the Moonkin Stone between Mulgore and the Barrens to bring forth Lunaclaw. From there, you must face Lunaclaw and earn the strength of body and heart it possesses. Speak with Turak Runetotem in Thunder Bluff when you are done.

6004.o: Kill 2 Scarlet Medics, 2 Scarlet Hunters, 2 Scarlet Magi and 2 Scarlet Knights before returning to Kirsta Deepshadow in Western Plaguelands.

6021.o: Bring Zaeldarr's Head to Caretaker Alen at Light's Hope Chapel.

6022.o: Travel to Corin's Crossing to the east and slaughter the Scourge that inhabit the town. Collect 7 pieces of Living Rot in under 10 minutes. Use the Mortar and Pestle to grind the Living Rot into Coagulated Rot.

6023.o: Kill Huntsman Radley and Cavalier Durgen before returning to Kirsta Deepshadow in Western Plaguelands.

6024.o: Kill Infiltrator Hameya. Use his key on the Mound of Dirt behind the Undercroft.

6025.o: Enter Hearthglen and find a high vantage point from which you can see the town and gauge the Scarlet Crusade's forces, then return to Kirsta Deepshadow in Western Plaguelands.
ob: Overlook Hearthglen from a high vantage point

6026.o: Smokey LaRue wants you to get 2 Thorium Bars, 1 Golden Rod, 8 Hi-Explosive Bombs, and 8 Unstable Triggers. You will have to find a blacksmith and an engineer for these items.

6027.o: Get the Book of the Ancients and return it to Azore Aldamort at the tower in Ethel Rethor.

6029.o: Deliver the Everlook Report to Argent Officer Garush at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

6030.o: Deliver the book, "Studies in Spirit Speaking", to Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff at Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands.

6031.o: Bring 30 Runecloth to Meilosh in Timbermaw Hold.

6032.o: Bring 2 Mooncloth to Meilosh in Timbermaw Hold.

6041.n: When Smokey Sings, I Get Violent
6041.o: Travel to Plaguewood, northwest of Light's Hope. Destroy 8 Scourge Structures by using Smokey's Special Compound at the Mark of Detonation planted inside each building. Smokey has had the Ziggurats and Slaughterhouses marked. Once you plant the bomb, leave the building and marvel at your handiwork. By the way, Smokey's Special Compound is rather... unstable.

6042.o: Slay 20 Noxious Plaguebats and 10 Monstrous Plaguebats. Return to Nathanos Blightcaller when you are finished.

6061.o: Use the Taming Rod to tame an Adult Plainstrider. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Yaw Sharpmane in Bloodhoof Village.

6062.o: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Dire Mottled Boar. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Thotar in Razor Hill.

6070.o: Speak with Thotar at Razor Hill.

6082.o: Use the Taming Rod to tame an Armored Scorpid. Practice your skills, then return to Thotar at Razor Hill.

6083.o: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Surf Crawler. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Thotar at Razor Hill.

6087.o: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Prairie Stalker. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Yaw Sharpmane in Bloodhoof Village.

6088.o: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Swoop. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Yaw Sharpmane in Bloodhoof Village.

6089.o: Speak with Holt Thunderhorn on Hunter Rise in Thunder Bluff.

6126.o: Travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven.

6127.o: Use the Empty Dreadmist Peak Sampler to draw a sample of water from a pool at the top of the peak. Deliver the Filled Dreadmist Peak Sampler to Tonga Runetotem at the Crossroads, Barrens.

6128.o: Bring 5 Earthroot and 5 Kodo Horns to Tonga Runetotem at the Crossroads so he may make a curative salve.

6129.o: Use the Curative Animal Salve on 10 Sickly Gazelles that are located throughout the northern part of the Barrens; doing so should cure them. Sickly Gazelles have been reported north of the east-west road that runs through the Crossroads.

6130.o: Return to Turak Runetotem on the Elder Rise, Thunder Bluff.

6132.o: Escort Melizza Brimbuzzle, then speak with Hornizz Brimbuzzle at the Kodo Graveyard in Desolace.

6133.o: Travel to the northern borders of the Eastern Plaguelands and recover the Quel'Thalas Registry. The item is somewhere in the Quel'Lithien lodge. You must also slay 8 Rangers, 8 Pathstriders, and 8 Woodsmen.

6134.o: Bring 8 Ghost-o-plasms and the Crate of Ghost Magnets to Hornizz Brimbuzzle in Desolace.

6135.n: Duskwing, Oh How I Hate Thee...
6135.o: Find Duskwing and slay him. From the corpse, recover a Patch of Duskwing's Fur and return it to Nathanos Blightcaller. It is said that Duskwing roams the countryside to the north of Marris Stead.

6136.o: Find Borelgore in the northern wastes of Eastern Plaguelands and destroy him. Return to Nathanos Blightcaller when the mission is complete.

6142.o: Find 10 pieces of Soft-shelled Clam Meat and bring it back to Mai'Lahii at Shadowprey Village.

6143.o: Slay 7 Slitherblade Myrmidon, 7 Slitherblade Naga, and 5 Slitherblade Sorceresses, and then talk to Drulzegar at Shadowprey in Desolace.

6144.o: Travel to the Undercity and speak with Varimathras.

6145.o: Return to Eastern Plaguelands and track down the Crimson Courier. Kill the Courier and recover the Grand Crusader's Command. Take the command to Nathanos Blightcaller for further instruction.

6146.o: Travel to Tyr's Hand, southeast of the Marris Stead. Once there, take a bite of the Rotten Apple. While under the guise of the Scarlet Crusade, deliver the Grand Crusader's Command to Crusader Lord Valdelmar.

6147.o: Return to Nathanos Blightcaller with the new information.

6148.o: The Scarlet Crusade is on the move. Somewhere along the road from Tyr's Hand to Stratholme you will find the Oracle, Demetria, and her entourage. Hunt her down and slay her. Return to Nathanos Blightcaller should you succeed.

6161.o: Find Rackmore's Silver Key. Find Rackmore's Golden Key. Find and open Rackmore's Chest.

6162.o: Kill Overlord Ror and return his claw to Dreka'Sur at Bloodvenom Post in Felwood.

6163.o: Travel to Stratholme and slay Ramstein the Gorger. Take his head as a souvenir for Nathanos.

6164.o: Bring Augustus' Receipt Book to Augustus the Touched in Terrordale.

6282.o: Maggran Earthbinder in Sun Rock Retreat wants you to slay 7 Bloodfury Harpies, 7 Bloodfury Ambushers, 7 Bloodfury Slayers and 7 Bloodfury Roguefeathers.

6283.o: Maggran at Sun Rock Retreat wishes you to slay Bloodfury Ripper and bring her remains as proof of your deed.

6284.o: Kill Besseleth and bring Besseleth's Fang to Maggran at Sun Rock Retreat.

6301.o: Tammra Windfield at Sun Rock Retreat wants you to gather 10 Gaea Seeds.

6321.o: Bring Podrig's Order to Karos Razok.

6322.o: Bring Gordon's Crate to Michael Garrett.

6323.o: Buy a bat ride to the Undercity from the bat master Karos Razok, then take Podrig's Order to Gordon Wendham in the Undercity.

6324.o: Buy a bat ride to the Sepulcher from the bat master Michael Garrett, then bring Gordon's Crate to Deathguard Podrig in the Sepulcher.

6361.o: Bring the Bundle of Hides to the wind rider master Devrak in the Crossroads.

6362.o: Buy a wind rider to Thunder Bluff from the wind rider master Devrak, then bring the Bundle of Hides to Ahanu in Thunder Bluff.

6363.o: Bring Ahanu's Leather Goods to Tal in Thunder Bluff.

6364.o: Buy a wind rider to the Crossroads from the wind rider master Tal, then bring Ahanu's Leather Goods to Jahan Hawkwing.

6365.o: Bring Zargh's Meats to Devrak in the Crossroads.

6381.o: Plant 10 Gaea Seeds in Gaea Dirt Mounds, and then return the remaining Enchanted Gaea Seeds to Tammra at Sun Rock Retreat.

6382.o: Speak with Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post, Ashenvale.

6384.o: Buy a wind rider to Orgrimmar from the wind rider master Devrak, then bring Zargh's Meats to Gryshka in Orgrimmar.

6385.o: Bring Gryshka's Letter to Doras in Orgrimmar.

6386.o: Buy a wind rider to the Crossroads from the wind rider master Doras, then bring Gryshka's Letter to Zargh at the Crossroads.

6390.o: Release the Plagueland Termites in the Northridge Lumber Mill, then return with the Barrel of Plagueland Termites to Mickey Levine at the Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.

6393.o: Bring 10 Incendrites to Tsunaman at Sun Rock Retreat.

6394.o: Bring Thazz'ril's Pick to Foreman Thazz'ril.

6395.o: Bring Samuel Fipps' Remains to Marla's Grave, then return to Novice Elreth.

6401.o: Tell Tammra Windfield in Sun Rock Retreat the good news.

6421.o: Explore deep into the cave at Boulderslide Ravine and bring back 10 Resonite Crystals for Mor'rogal at Sun Rock Retreat to investigate.

6441.o: Collect 16 Satyr Horns for Pixel in Splintertree Post.

6442.o: Bring 20 Wrathtail Heads to Marukai along the Zoram Strand.

6461.o: Xen'zilla at Malaka'Jin needs you to kill 10 Deepmoss Creepers and 7 Deepmoss Venomspitters.

6462.o: Bring 8 Troll Charms to Mitsuwa at the Zoram'gar Outpost.

6481.o: Open the Resonite cask with the Enchanted Resonite Crystal, and then slay Goggeroc. Return to Mor'rogal with the news and Enchanted Resonite Crystal.

6482.o: Escort Ruul, then speak with Yama Snowhoof in Splintertree Post.

6503.o: Kill 9 Ashenvale Outrunners, then return to Kuray'bin at Splintertree Outpost.

6504.o: Find the 12 missing pages of the Shredder Operating Manual, and put them together to form Chapters 1, 2, and 3. Return the pages to Gurda Ragescar near Splintertree Post.

6521.o: Bring Ambassador Malcin's Head to Varimathras in the Undercity.

6522.o: Take the Small Scroll to Varimathras in the Undercity.

6523.o: Escort Kaya Flathoof to Camp Aparaje, and then return to Makaba Flathoof near the southeastern edge of Stonetalon.

6541.o: Report to Kadrak at the watch tower in northern Barrens.

6542.o: Report to Kadrak at the watch tower in northern Barrens.

6543.o: Open the Bundle of Reports. Take the Warsong Reports to the Warsong Scout, Warsong Runner, and Warsong Outrider. Bring back the updates they give you to Kadrak at the northern watch tower in the barrens.

6544.o: Escort Torek on his attack against Silverwing Outpost and Duriel Moonfire, then report to Ertog Ragetusk at Splintertree Post.

6548.o: Kill 8 Grimtotem Ruffians and 6 Grimtotem Mercenaries, and then return to Makaba Flathoof near the southeastern edge of Stonetalon.

6561.o: Bring the head of Twilight Lord Kelris to Bashana Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.

6562.o: Speak to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.

6563.o: Bring 20 Sapphires of Aku'Mai to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.

6564.o: Bring the Damp Note to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.

6565.o: Kill Lorgus Jett in Blackfathom Deeps and then return to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.

6567.o: Seek out Rexxar. The Warchief has instructed you as to his whereabouts. Search the paths of Desolace, between the Stonetalon Mountains and Feralas.

6568.o: Deliver Rexxar's Letter to Myranda the Hag in the Western Plaguelands.

6569.o: Travel to Blackrock Spire and collect 20 Black Dragonspawn Eyes. Return to Myranda the Hag when the task is complete.

6570.o: Travel to the Wyrmbog in Dustwallow Marsh and seek out Emberstrife's Den. Once inside, wear the Amulet of Draconic Subversion and speak with Emberstrife.

6571.o: Collect the Warsong Supplies: Warsong Saw Blades, Logging Rope, Warsong Oil, and the Warsong Axe Shipment for Locke Okarr in Splintertree Post.

6582.o: You must find the blue dragonflight drake champion, Scryer, and slay him. Pry his skull from his corpse and return it to Emberstrife. You know that Scryer can be found in Winterspring.

6583.o: Destroy the drake champion of the Green Flight, Somnus. Take his skull and return it to Emberstrife.

6584.o: Guarding the Caverns of Time in the Tanaris Desert is Chronalis, child of Nozdormu. Destroy him and return his skull to Emberstrife.

6585.o: Travel to Grim Batol and track down Axtroz, drake champion of the Red Flight. Destroy him and take his skull. Return the skull to Emberstrife.

6601.o: It would appear as if the charade is over. You know that the Amulet of Draconic Subversion that Myranda the Hag created for you will not function inside Blackrock Spire. Perhaps you should find Rexxar and explain your predicament. Show him the Dull Drakefire Amulet. Hopefully he will know what to do next.

6602.n: Blood of the Black Dragon Champion
6602.o: Travel to Blackrock Spire and slay General Drakkisath. Gather his blood and return it to Rexxar.
ob: Blood of the Black Dragon Champion

6603.o: Find Donova Snowden near the hot springs in Winterspring.

6605.o: Speak with Winna Hazzard in Felwood.

6606.o: Speak with Witch Doctor Mau'ari in Everlook.

6607.o: Nat Pagle wants you to catch the following fish: Misty Reed Mahi Mahi from the Misty Reed Strand in the Swamp of Sorrows. A Sar'theris Striker from the Sar'theris Strand in Desolace. Feralas Ahi from the Verdantis River of Feralas. Savage Coast Blue Sailfin from the Savage Coast of Stranglethorn Vale. Return to Nat Pagle when you have reeled them all in!

6608.o: You think Lumak is trying to tell you that he can no longer help you improve your fishing skill. You may want to try to find his friend, Nat Pagle, a human fishing off one of the islands south of Theramore (at least that's what you think Lumak said).

6610.o: Dirge Quikcleave wants you to get the following items: 12 Giant Eggs. You will find those on the Rocs wandering Tanaris or any other species of large bird. 10 pieces of Zesty Clam Meat. You can find those in clams, naturally! 20 pieces of Alterac Swiss. Get thee to a cheesery! Gather all of the items and return to Dirge.

6611.o: Travel to Gadgetzan in the Tanaris desert and speak with Dirge Quikcleave about advancing your cooking career.

6621.o: Place Karang's Banner on the Foulweald Totem Mound. Do not let the furbolgs destroy the banner. Defeat Chief Murgut and bring Murgut's Totem to Karang Amakkar at Zoram'gar.

6622.o: Save patients by using Triage Bandages to tend to their wounds. You must save 15 patients before 6 of them die from their injuries. Remember the order of triage! Critically Injured Soldiers die the fastest followed by Badly Injured Soldiers. Injured Soldiers take the longest to die and should be saved AFTER your Critically Injured and Badly Injured Soldiers have been triaged.

6623.o: Travel to Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands and speak with Doctor Gregory Victor about joining the ranks of Horde Trauma.

6626.o: Kill 8 Razorfen Battleguard, 8 Razorfen Thornweavers, and 8 Death's Head Cultists and return to Myriam Moonsinger near the entrance to Razorfen Downs.

6627.o: Answer Braug Dimspirit's question successfully and then speak to him again. He will remain in Stonetalon Mountains when you are ready.

6628.o: Answer Parqual Fintallas' question successfully and then speak to him again. He will remain in the Undercity until you are ready.

6629.o: Kill Grundig Darkcloud and 6 Grimtotem Brutes, and return to Makaba Flathoof near the southeastern edge of Stonetalon.

6641.o: Keep Muglash safe as he travels to the brazier. Help him by putting the brazier out, then protect him as you fight against the Naga. If you are successful, return to the Zoram'gar Outpost and inform the Warsong Runner of the death of Vorsha the Lasher.

6681.o: Take the Seal of Ravenholdt to Fahrad at Ravenholdt Manor, hidden away in the hills of Hillsbrad. Your cunning will be tested along the way. Be prepared.

6804.o: Use the Aspect of Neptulon on poisoned elementals of Eastern Plaguelands. Bring 12 Discordant Bracers and the Aspect of Neptulon to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

6805.o: Kill 15 Dust Stormers and 15 Desert Rumblers and then return to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

6821.o: Bring the Eye of the Emberseer to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

6822.o: Kill 1 Fire Lord, 1 Molten Giant, 1 Ancient Core Hound and 1 Lava Surger, then return to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

6823.o: Earn an Honored faction with the Hydraxian Waterlords, then talk to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

6824.o: Bring the Hands of Lucifron, Sulfuron, Gehennas and Shazzrah to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

6844.o: Take the Encrusted Silithid Object to Umber - the Cenarion Circle's archivist - in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.

6845.o: Speak with Rabine Saturna in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.

6847.o: Recover Master Ryson's All Seeing Eye from the Winterax caves and return it to Master Ryson. Be warned, it is said that Master Ryson's All Seeing Eye carries with it a terrible curse!

6921.o: Bring the Fathom Core to Je'neu Sancrea at Zoram'gar Outpost, Ashenvale.

6922.o: Bring the Strange Water Globe to Je'neu Sancrea at Zoram'gar Outpost, Ashenvale.

6961.o: Speak with Greatfather Winter; he is located near the Smokywood Pastures vendor area in Orgrimmar.

6962.o: Bring 5 Gingerbread Cookies and an Ice Cold Milk to Great-father Winter in Orgrimmar.

6963.o: Locate the Smokywood Pastures investigator that has gone missing in the snowy regions of the Alterac Mountains.

6964.o: Speak with Sagorne Creststrider in the Valley of Wisdom of Orgrimmar about the Feast of Winter Veil.

6981.o: Travel to Ratchet to find someone that can tell you more about the glowing shard. Then, deliver the shard as you are directed.

6983.o: Locate and return the Stolen Treats to Kaymard Copperpinch in Orgrimmar. It was last thought to be in the possession of the Abominable Greench, found somewhere in the snowy regions of the Alterac Mountains.

6984.o: Speak with Great-father Winter in Orgrimmar.

6985.o: Bring 10 Irondeep Supplies to the Horde Quartermaster in Frostwolf Keep.

7001.o: Locate a Frostwolf in Alterac Valley. Use the Frostwolf Muzzle when you are near the Frostwolf to 'tame' the beast. Once tamed, the Frostwolf will follow you back to the Frostwolf Stable Master. Speak with the Frostwolf Stable Master to earn credit for the capture.

7003.o: Use Zorbin's Ultra-Shrinker to zap any kind of giant found in Feralas into a more manageable form. Bring 15 Miniaturization Residues found on the zapped versions of these giants to Zorbin Fandazzle at the docks of the Forgotten Coast, Feralas.

7021.o: Speak with Greatfather Winter; he is located near the Smokywood Pastures vendor area in Orgrimmar.

7024.o: Speak with Greatfather Winter; he is located near the Smokywood Pastures vendor area in Orgrimmar.

7028.o: Collect 15 Theradric Crystal Carvings for Willow in Desolace.

7029.o: Fill the Coated Cerulean Vial at the orange crystal pool in Maraudon. Use the Filled Cerulean Vial on the Vylestem Vines to force the corrupted Noxxious Scion to emerge. Heal 8 plants by killing these Noxxious Scion, then return to Vark Battlescar in Shadowprey Village.

7044.o: Recover the two parts of the Scepter of Celebras: the Celebrian Rod and the Celebrian Diamond. Find a way to speak with Celebras.

7046.o: Assist Celebras the Redeemed while he creates the Scepter of Celebras. Speak with him when the ritual is complete.

7061.o: Feel free to read the book, "The Feast of Winter Veil", to learn more about the holiday. When you are finished with the book, deliver it to Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff.

7064.o: Slay Princess Theradras and return to Selendra near Shadowprey Village in Desolace.

7066.o: Seek out Remulos in Moonglade and give him the Seed of Life.

7067.o: Read the Pariah's Instructions. Afterwards, obtain the Amulet of Union from Maraudon and return it to the Centaur Pariah in southern Desolace.

7068.o: Collect 10 Shadowshard Fragments from Maraudon and return them to Uthel'nay in Orgrimmar.

7082.o: Assault a graveyard, then return to Corporal Teeka Bloodsnarl in the Alterac Mountains.

7101.o: Capture an enemy tower, then return to Corporal Teeka Bloodsnarl in the Alterac Mountains.

7124.o: Capture a mine, then return to Corporal Teeka Bloodsnarl in the Alterac Mountains.

7142.o: Enter Alterac Valley and defeat the dwarven general, Vanndar Stormpike. Then, return to Voggah Deathgrip in the Alterac Mountains.

7161.o: Travel to the Wildpaw cavern located southeast of the main base in Alterac Valley and find the Frostwolf Banner. Return the Frostwolf Banner to Warmaster Laggrond.

7181.o: According to legend, the leader of the mighty Winterax trolls appears at will to wreak havoc on the denizens of Alterac Valley. Should Korrak make himself known, destroy him and return to Warmaster Laggrond.

7201.o: Travel to Blackrock Depths and recover 10 Essence of the Elements. Your first inclination is to search the golems and golem makers. You remember Vivian Lagrave also muttering something about elementals.

7222.o: Speak with Voggah in Frostwolf Keep.

7224.o: Bring 20 Armor Scraps to Smith Regzar in Frostwolf Village.

7241.o: Venture to Alterac Valley, located in the Alterac Mountains. Find and speak with Warmaster Laggrond - who stands outside the tunnel entrance - to begin your career as a soldier of Frostwolf. You will find Alterac Valley north of Tarren Mill at the base of the Alterac Mountains.

7281.o: Travel into Stormpike territory and slay Commander Karl Philips. Return to Commander Louis Philips when the task is complete.

7302.o: Find out what became of Wing Commander Guse, Wing Commander Jeztor, and Wing Commander Mulverick. Return to Commander Mulfort should you complete your mission.

7321.o: Bring 10 pieces of Turtle Meat and some Soothing Spices to Christoph Jeffcoat in Tarren Mill.

7361.o: You have been tasked with slaying opposing night elf players in Alterac Valley. Kill a night elf and return to Najak Hexxen at Frostwolf Keep with a Severed Night Elf Head.

7362.o: You have been tasked with slaying opposing gnome players in Alterac Valley. Kill a gnome and return to Ravak Grimtotem at Frostwolf Keep with a Tuft of Gnome Hair.

7363.o: You have been tasked with slaying opposing human players in Alterac Valley. Kill a human and return to Commander Louis Philips (who wanders between the front lines and Frostwolf keep) with a Human Bone Chip. A cure for the human condition is close at hand!
